SHITET APARTAMENT 3+1 NE LAPRAKE.
Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe prej 114.6m2 dhe nje verande prej 45.97m2.
Ndodhet ne katin e 4-te te nje pallati i cili ka perfunduar ne 2020.
Apartamenti organizohet nga nje sallon dhe kuzhine, tre dhoma gjumi, nje tualet, nje verand dhe nje ballkon.
Orientimi i apartamentit eshte Jug- perendim.
Per me shume informacione na kontaktoni!
description_en: 3+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE IN LAPRAKE. The apartment has a surface of 114.6m2 and a veranda of 45.97m2. It is located on the 4th floor of a building which was completed in 2020. The apartment is organized by a living room and kitchen, three bedrooms, a bathroom, a veranda and a balcony. The orientation of the apartment is South-west. For more information contact us!
